description: This file is a shell script used for performance testing Git clone operations with reference repositories. It defines test cases that measure the speed of cloning repositories using a shared reference to optimize the process.

methods.name: test_perf_default_repo
methods.description: Initializes or prepares a default test repository for performance testing.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed, with a description and commands.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs a performance test with specified commands.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script, finalizing or cleaning up test environment.
